However, the landscape around the fort is marked with caverns, chasms, and natural bridges, which the local merchants use to escape the ever-vigilant eye of [[Varesh Ossa|Warmarshal Varesh]]'s minions. }} '''Pogahn Passage''' is a rocky area with twisted pathways that lies to the north of the formidable fortress of [[Gandara]]. ==Getting there== Travel southeast from [[Yohlon Haven]] through [[Arkjok Ward]] to find this outpost on the southeastern corner. While the [[primary quest]] [[No Me, No Kormir]] (if your character sided with [[Margrid the Sly]]) eventually leads here, your character is more likely to initially arrive at this location while pursuing [[secondary quest]]s such as [[the Dejarin Estate]] or [[A Fool's Luck]].
